lines.text: When the nations are driven out, three cities are to be set apart, with roads so any manslayer can flee.
A man who kills his neighbor accidentally when an axe blade flies off the handle may flee to a city.
If the LORD gives all the promised land and Israel obeys, they are to add seven more cities.
If a man hates his neighbor, kills him, and flees to a city, the priests must bring him back.
A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses, since a lone witness is not sufficient.
